title: quercus rubra f. triloba
intro: Quercus rubra f. triloba, commonly known as Red Oak, is a subspecies of the Red Oak tree that is native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that provide numerous health benefits, such as reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Quercus rubra f. triloba include inhibiting the growth of cancer cells, protecting against neurodegenerative diseases, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
